lines.t: Peak started as a one month game jam, and sold over ten million copies.
You and up to three friends are Scouts, stranded after a plane crash. The only way out is up.
You climb a huge mountain, while managing a stamina bar.
Hunger, injuries, weight, poison and cold all shrink your stamina.
There are six biomes, and the mountain changes every 24 hours.
Climb too far ahead of your group, and the Scoutmaster shows up.
It was made by two studios, Aggro Crab and Landfall, during a game jam in South Korea.

sc.sub: Aggro Crab + Landfall, in South Korea

lines.t: It launched in June 2025, and sold 100,000 copies in 24 hours.
A million in the first week. Five million in the first month.
By mid August, it passed ten million.
It won Best Multiplayer Game at the Golden Joysticks, and Better With Friends at the Steam Awards.
Streamers loved it too. It won Stream Game of the Year at The Streamer Awards.
It even had an in-game concert with bbno$, and a Fortnite bundle. Then this August, The Final Ascent update arrived.
lines.say: It even had an in-game concert with baby no money, and a Fortnite bundle. Then this August, The Final Ascent update arrived.
